correctness.rationale: The eight square-antiprism vertices, sixteen edges, and Haar central-plane sampling are specified for all h>0. The included Q[t]/(t^4-2) exact chamber checker enumerates 58 normal-sign chambers of the regular antiprism, with 24 six-edge and 34 eight-edge cuts and no triple great-circle intersections; nonsingular vertical affine scaling preserves the two possible polygon types for any h>0. For each edge, crossing probability equals its endpoint angle divided by pi; eight base and eight lateral edges give E N=8/pi(acos(h^2/(1+h^2))+acos((1/sqrt2-h^2)/(1+h^2))). Since N=6 or 8, the exact octagon formula follows, and direct differentiability/strict positive derivative establishes monotone 0-to-1 and inverse height rigidity. The regular h^2=1/(2sqrt2) gives 0.327044097... . Direct independent evaluation agreed with the earlier published formula at h=.2,.5,2^(-3/4),1,3. Numerical checks alone are not an all-height proof; chamber and angle arguments supply it.
